activity.notes: Drake commanded the English circumnavigation of 1577–1580. Royal Museums Greenwich identifies him as the first Englishman to circumnavigate the globe and notes that the voyage was a Crown-sanctioned privateering expedition against Spanish interests.

sources.title: Sir Francis Drake, 1540–96 — Royal Museums Greenwich
sources.citation_text: Identifies Drake as commander of the successful 1577–1580 circumnavigation and the first Englishman to circumnavigate the world.

sources.title: Sir Francis Drake facts — Royal Museums Greenwich
sources.citation_text: Describes Drake's circumnavigation as a secret privateering mission sanctioned by Elizabeth I against Spanish colonies and shipping.
